Projects

E.M.P.O.W.E.R. Android Mobile Application
Frontend → Backend Developer
Team Project

A mobile bookkeeping app built for DSWD-SLP (Sustainable Livelihood Program) beneficiaries — "Enhancing Micro-entrepreneurs' Proficiency in Organizing and Wise Earnings Recording." Manual bookkeeping was leading to inaccurate financial tracking, so the app gives micro-entrepreneurs a structured digital tool with PIN login, sales recording, expense tracking, stock & inventory management, payables monitoring, and automated reports (including a generated balance sheet). Field-tested directly with DSWD-SLP beneficiaries and presented at TechXpo 2026, CTU – Ginatilan Extension Campus. Recognized with a Certificate of Appreciation from DSWD Field Office 7. Over the course of the project, I gained hands-on experience across the stack — building the user interface, contributing to the server-side logic and data handling, and conducting manual quality assurance testing to catch issues before release.

INVRTY·SYS
Solo Developer
Prototype · In Progress

An unfinished prototype, built as a personal side project. A free, single-file, browser-based store management system built for Filipino sari-sari store owners. Runs entirely in one HTML file — no installation, no internet, and no server required. Covers inventory management (Standard, Variant, and Tingi pricing tiers with low-stock alerts), a tap-to-sell point-of-sale with cash and utang (credit) checkout, a full customer credit ledger, manual stock transactions, and a 5-tab reports dashboard (Overview, Sales, Inventory, Utang, Activity Log) with CSV export. Includes light and dark mode.
